scientific_integrity: The monoid definition and unique-extension lemma are credited to Fernandes; generic forbidden-run transfer matrices and orbit decomposition are standard tools, not claimed as new. No independent audit or validation has taken place.
scientific_limitations: The stated enumerator concerns nonempty restrictions of a fixed regular cyclic group and a single zero. Asymptotics give first-order logarithmic concentration only. The general proof is mathematical; exhaustive checking was restricted to n=2,...,10. The literature overlap assessment is not exhaustive publication-priority certification.
title: Rank–nilpotency spectra and arithmetic upper tails in cyclic inverse monoids
